task_scope: Two independent seeded Workbench source repairs: state_t/action_t alignment and accepted-only LeRobot export. Each reruns three native CPU MuJoCo Fetch cases with a separate verifier.
routing: One structured Lightning classification per task selects an allowed endpoint. LangGraph workers operate Workbench; required source-bound checks determine completion.
measured_modes: Two reversed-order pairs with predefined direct dispatch and Astra available for escalation; a separate pair with actual Astra delegation.

price_snapshot.description: Published standard API-equivalent rates; not an invoice. Both Astra context tariffs retained unless per-request evidence proves short context. Full ToFa input tariff without an assumed cache discount. All routing/generation/recovery attempts included.

astra_tariff_applicability.note: A fresh turn with complete aggregate input and output usage totaling less than 272000 bounds every included request below the threshold. Otherwise retain both rates unless request-level proof exists. Confirm actual service tier before estimating; priority, batch and flex multipliers are not applied here.

evidence_policy: Raw credentials, host details and transcripts remain private. Export contains public model IDs, numeric counters, actual patches and hash-bound acceptance.
prior_experiments: Earlier model screening and failures remain separate and unchanged; this report contains every arm of the predeclared routed comparisons.
limitations: Small matched experiments on fixed seeded defects do not establish general superiority or calibrated routing accuracy.
The router selected Flash for every observed task; this does not test routing to the larger model or quantify the router benefit against always choosing Flash.
Direct dispatch assumes operator-provided task decomposition; those successful hybrid runs used zero Astra invocations.
Astra used ChatGPT authentication. Published standard API equivalents are not actual cash invoices or subscriber-quota accounting. Billed service tier is unproven.
Request-level completion counters are matched to thread identities; separately observed input-only setup events are retained as cost sensitivity because their billing is unknown.
ToFa uses full input tariffs without an undocumented cache discount. Reasoning output is not charged twice.
CPU hosting, storage, network, development conversations and separate live validation are excluded from timed-arm model costs.
This is local CPU simulation and dataset repair, not cloud GPU submission, learned policy training or physical robot transfer.

Finite native and held-out checks establish the stated contract only. One Flash export patch additionally skips accepted records without simulation metadata; that malformed-input policy was not evaluated and should be reviewed before production adoption.
